name: Lille logistics coordinator seeking stable daytime employment

context.geography: Lille metropolitan area, including nearby commutable towns
constraints: Coordination or supply-chain work, not automatically warehouse picking
context.company_awareness: Recognizes regional industrial and retail employers but has no settled shortlist

trigger: A promising daytime logistics advertisement turns out to be an agency warehouse assignment rather than a permanent coordination job.

searches_run.observation: Retrieval included a CDI coordinator advertisement and a transport coordinator result from Cap emploi. Opening the latter returned a notice that the offer no longer exists; the retrieved snippet could not be treated as a live vacancy.

searches_run.query: emploi logistique Lille horaires journée CDI sans intérim
searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned many agency/warehouse results despite the exclusion intent. An inspected CRIT page states specific weekday hours but also explicitly describes an interim assignment in order picking.

sources.title: Coordinateur Logistique H/F — Otteo / Jobintree
sources.supports: Retrieved result describes CDI coordination with international transport and ERP responsibilities; direct-employer status and schedule were not verified.

sources.title: Offre d'emploi — Cap emploi 59 Lille
sources.supports: Retrieved snippet described a CDI transport coordinator; direct inspection instead showed that the offer no longer exists.

sources.title: Agent logistique — CRIT Lesquin
sources.supports: Direct inspection states agency recruitment for a client, order-picking duties, weekday daytime hours and an 18-month interim contract. Specific hours do not establish the requested role or permanent employment.

best_entry_page.promise: Introduce covered local employers with relevant coordination roles, linking to the original contract and hours wording where available.
best_entry_page.cta: Voir les employeurs et vérifier les postes
proof_needed: Verified regional employer and career-board coverage
Clear role boundary between coordination and picking
Actual employing entity distinguished from agency or consultancy
Date and source for each role and schedule claim
No live opening or day-shift claim when unknown
New indexable guide; company/search pages currently noindex

conversion_objections: Does this list actual local employers or another set of agencies?
Will logistique mostly return warehouse picking?
Does CDI describe this vacancy or the agency's general recruitment options?
Are exact hours available before I apply?
Is the site genuinely in Lille or outside a practical commute?

avoid_targeting.query: emploi logistique Lille CDI horaires fixes garantis
avoid_targeting.reason: Contract and shift arrangements require employer evidence.
Different role and contract preference from this persona.
The persona prioritizes direct employers; agency recommendations are not the product.

message_to_founder: Simulation : Je cherche un poste de coordination avec un employeur identifiable, pas n’importe quelle annonce contenant logistique. Donnez-moi le lieu réel, le contrat et les horaires annoncés avant de me demander de créer un compte.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona, two queries, two direct inspections. Other query rows are modeled, not observed demand. No volume or rankings inferred. One unavailable source illustrates a retrieval/source discrepancy, not a general staleness rate. Employment-type filters exist, but direct-employer exclusion and rota verification are not demonstrated. Local coverage remains unverified.

search_journey.fit_reason: Role, location and employment type fit if employers are covered.
Role discovery helps but may return unsuitable seniority.

search_journey.need: Broaden titles while retaining contract needs.
search_journey.fit_reason: Filtering can help; duties must remain comparable.
